clock.access: Official data-model page returned by Search Service
clock.finding: TRADINGPRICE describes five-minute spot market prices, and PERIODID 1 is the interval ending 00:05 AEST. Its revision notes distinguish RRP from pre-adjustment ROP. Some descriptive sentences still refer to the former 30-minute system; do not apply those stale cadence sentences to the observed 2026 five-minute files.
The Electricity Data Model describes NEM time as fixed UTC+10.

clock.access: Official AEMO PDF excerpt returned by Search Service
clock.finding: The NEM-time timestamp convention is AEST with +10:00 offset and dispatch-interval-ending alignment. This supports the market-clock convention, not any VPP-data substitution.

price_definition.access: Current official page opened through Search Service; direct workspace curl received403, retained in acquisition.json.
price_definition.finding: The dispatch price view describes five-minute current/historical spot prices; displayed spot prices are time weighted, with the source named TradingPrice.RRP. The average-price explanation gives RRP units of dollars perMWh. Forecast pre-dispatch prices are a separate series.

observed_semantics: Both monthly CSV files provide REGION, SETTLEMENTDATE, TOTALDEMAND, RRP and PERIODTYPE; selected rows are exactly TRADE. TOTALDEMAND is retained only because complete original CSV lines are kept; it is not used in price calculations.

Observed September files contain 8,640 five-minute rows each and include October 1 midnight; October files start October 1 at 00:05. A single target calendar day is owned by the month containing its interval starts.

PUBLIC_PRICES daily files contain DREGION versions 2 and 3 and span 04:05 through the next 04:00. Two adjacent trading-day bundles were used to assemble the target calendar day. Version 3 is selected explicitly and each selected version-2 RRP is retained to demonstrate identical price values across layouts.
The complete 576 regional comparisons use PUBLIC_PRICES/DREGION rather than DISPATCH/PRICE. There is no PRICESTATUS field in these retained tables and no FIRM or finality claim.

The selected daily rows all have RUNNO 1, INTERVENTION 0, APCFLAG 0 and MARKETSUSPENDEDFLAG 0. These flags describe this acquired specimen and do not certify future prices or an immutable final vintage.

The monthly files publish cents or integer zeros; daily RRP retains higher precision and one positive scientific-notation value, 3E-05. Decimal extraction preserves that value. No monthly zero masked a negative daily price in this specimen.

The monthly refresh/correction service level and finality are not established. Prices can be revised; source-vintage hashes are retained. No older day or alternate publisher dataset is silently substituted.
independence_limit: Both presentations share AEMO market-calculation lineage. Different daily/monthly transport and independent Python CSV/Decimal extraction check selection, coverage, rounded prices and summaries, not independent market clearing.
privacy: No HTMLfooter, contacts, personalrecords, credentials or unrelated unit-level records are retained.
